response.sql: SELECT ma.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(i2.amount) FROM income i2 JOIN member m2 ON i2.link_to_member = m2.member_id JOIN major ma2 ON m2.link_to_major = ma2.major_id) AS fraction FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.college
